## Projects Department Health & Safety Standards

Ref: EGY/PRJCTS/HSE/REQs

- Emergency preparedness and response
- oFirst aid, etc.
- unless it can be proven that the in-house provider has the necessary competencies. Specialized training being carried out in-house is to be reviewed by Emaar Misr prior to implementation.

## 2.4.3.2.5. Tool Box Talks:

- Contractors shall ensure that regular tool box talk is given to the workforce (in general at least every 7 days).
- Tool box talks arc to bc short duration and focus on just one topic to update/remind or inform staff and workers about key health and safety messages. Toolbox talks must be relevant and appropriate to the audience and given in the workers language.
- An attendance sheet is to be signed by all participants and a copy of the most current tool box talk posted on the site noticeboard.

## 2.4.3.2.6. Training Records:

- > Records of training and assessment including tool box talks are to be maintained for review and audit.ThemonthlyHSEReportistoincludeinformation on courses and number of traininghours completed during the reporting period.

## 2.4.3.3.Behaviors:

- A Program Partners shall ensure,through its policies,training and supervision that all personnel are aware of basic behavioral requirements including:
- Stop,ask and don't put yourself at risk
- ·Always consider safetyfirst in local decisions and choices
- Share expertise and knowledge in an open way
- Respect good site practice and avoid horseplay
- Respect for other people, including no use of foul, abusive or racist language
- oNo aggressive or violent behavior
- No harassment or bullying
- Control of these behaviors is in the hands of both management and staff and operatives however it is anticipated that an Enforcement process/procedure will be prepared and implemented to drive positive behavior where disregard for safety by employees/operatives or others associated with the workwill potentiallyexpose them,or others,to danger.
- employees with an opportunity to engage with management and resolve unsafe activities at source. A disciplinary process for repeated violations of site safety rules shall also be incorporated.
